items.details: Flew from Queenstown to Christchurch to start the trip; picked up the campervan at Christchurch airport.
items.name: Flight to Christchurch

items.details: Britz campervan, the group's wheels for the trip.
items.name: Britz Campervan

items.details: Hip restaurant in Sumner, Christchurch, in a building that once housed mutineers from an English settling mission; dinner on arrival night.
items.name: The Clink

items.details: Limestone boulder field at the foothills of the Southern Alps, 2 hours from Christchurch; film location for the final battle of the Chronicles of Narnia; visited at sunrise.
items.name: Castle Hill

items.details: Waterfall walk in Arthur's Pass; saw cheeky kea, the world's only alpine parrot, at a high viewpoint.
items.name: Devil's Punchbowl falls and kea spotting

items.details: Brewery tour in Greymouth - learned the story behind the classic kiwi beer brand, how it is brewed, plus tasting.
items.name: Monteith's Brewery tour

items.details: 5-star luxury lodge in Franz Josef; her room followed by a 5-course degustation menu at the on-site restaurant.
items.name: Te Waonui Forest Retreat

items.details: 5-course degustation dinner at the Te Waonui Forest Retreat, including raspberry sorbet served in bubbles.
items.name: Canopy Restaurant

items.details: Scenic helicopter flight out to Fox Glacier, landing on a big ice field, then flying back over Franz Josef glacier.
items.name: Glacier helicopter scenic flight and landing

items.details: Drove the Haast Pass from Fox Glacier to Wanaka; build in extra time for waterfall and glacial river stops.
items.location: Fox Glacier to Wanaka via Haast Pass
items.name: Haast Pass drive

items.details: Luxury alpine lodge high on Dragonfly Peak, reached by helicopter; dinner, wine and stargazing under a full moon.
items.name: Whare Kea Chalet

items.details: Backcountry 4WD trip up to Macetown with river crossings and deep green and gold gorges.
items.name: Nomad Safaris Macetown trip

items.details: Final lunch of the trip at the winery near Queenstown before the group flew home.
items.name: Amisfield winery

itineraries.summary: A week-long South Island road trip by campervan starting in Christchurch and ending in Queenstown, with highlights including Castle Hill's Narnia boulders, Arthur's Pass, a Greymouth brewery tour, the glaciers of Franz Josef and Fox, a luxury night at Whare Kea Chalet above Wanaka, and a 4WD trip near Arrowtown.
itineraries.title: South Island Road Trip - Part 1 (Christchurch to Queenstown)

items.details: Flew from Queenstown to Christchurch, then met the group at the Commodore Hotel before picking up the campervan.
items.name: Flight to Christchurch

items.details: Meeting point and first night in Christchurch; Britz Campervan picked up for the next 5 days.
items.name: Commodore Hotel

items.details: Campervan rented for 5 days, picked up in Christchurch.
items.name: Britz Campervan (5-day rental)

items.details: Hot air ballooning at sunrise over the Canterbury plains with a locally owned and run company.
items.name: Ballooning Canterbury

items.details: Afternoon whale watching tour; saw several sperm whales in calm seas.
items.name: Whale Watch Kaikoura

items.details: Beachfront accommodation in Kaikoura; crayfish (lobster) dinner and a misty sunset beach walk.
items.name: White Morph

items.details: Small boat tour at sunrise to see albatrosses with a pod of dolphins on the cruise back to land.
items.name: Albatross Encounter

items.details: Kayak trip across the Marlborough Sounds from Picton with Wilderness Guides; water clear and turquoise on the sheltered side.
items.name: Wilderness Guides kayak

items.details: Retreat right on the water in the Sounds, alone in the wild with nothing but nature around.
items.name: Raetihi Lodge

items.details: Peter Jackson's collection of WWI aircraft in Blenheim.
items.name: Omaka Aviation Heritage Museum

items.details: Base for exploring Marlborough wine country around Blenheim's Golden Mile.
items.name: Marlborough Vintners Hotel

items.details: Bike hire for cycling between vineyards on Blenheim's Golden Mile.
items.name: Wine Tours By Bike

items.details: Lunch stop on the bike wine tour before visiting more wineries.
items.name: Wairau River Wines

items.details: Cellar door visit; award-winning winery known for playing classical music to the vines and using mini sheep to mow between rows.
items.name: Yealands winery

items.details: Old-world style hotel in the famously 'kiwi' holiday town; evening soaking at the thermal hot pools.
items.name: Heritage Hotel

items.details: Adventure morning exploring the Hanmer Springs area by quad bike.
items.name: Hanmer Adventure quad bikes

items.details: Final lunch in the Waipara Valley wine region - Pinot Noir and a gourmet meal on the way to the airport.
items.name: Black Estate

itineraries.summary: A road trip up the South Island's north coast and top of the island by campervan: Christchurch, hot air ballooning in Darfield, whale watching and albatross tours in Kaikoura, kayaking the Marlborough Sounds, two days of wine touring around Blenheim, thermal pools and quad biking in Hanmer Springs, and a final Waipara Valley lunch.
itineraries.title: South Island Road Trip - Part 2 (North Coast & Wine Country)

extractions.notes: Liz Carlson's youngadventuress.com is the richest source in this batch. Part 1 is explicitly framed as an itinerary post ('I don't normally write itinerary posts but...'). Part 2 is presented as a road trip itinerary ('to give you an idea for a road trip itinerary'). Days are explicit for Part 1 (a week); Part 2's total is unstated (~6-7 days with a 5-day campervan rental), so days=null there.

itineraries.country: Caribbean (St. Lucia, St. Vincent & the Grenadines)

items.details: Board the yacht in Castries, capital of St. Lucia; 1-hour cruise to Marigot Bay, described as the most beautiful bay in the Caribbean; lunch in the bay then visit the twin volcanic peaks of the Pitons.
items.location: Castries to Marigot Bay, St. Lucia
items.name: Cruise to Marigot Bay (1 hour)

items.details: Visit the twin volcanic peaks after lunch in Marigot Bay.
items.name: Pitons

items.details: Depart at dawn; 4-hour cruise from Castries to Bequia.
items.name: Cruise to Bequia (4 hours)

items.details: White sand beaches and clear blue water, ideal for snorkeling, diving and other water sports.
items.name: Bequia snorkeling and diving

items.details: 2-hour cruise from Bequia to volcanic Union Island.
items.name: Cruise to Union Island (2 hours)

items.details: Afternoon relaxing on white sandy beaches under idyllic palms or swimming in clear waters; anchor offshore for the night.
items.name: Union Island beaches

items.details: 30-minute cruise from Union Island to Tobago Cays.
items.name: Cruise to Tobago Cays (30 min)

items.details: Explore the cluster of uninhabited islands protected by the famous horseshoe reef; superb snorkeling and some of the finest diving in the Caribbean.
items.name: Tobago Cays snorkeling and diving

items.details: Mid-morning departure; 1-hour cruise from Tobago Cays to Mustique.
items.name: Cruise to Mustique (1 hour)

items.details: Secluded 1,400-acre island of pure white sand beaches; horseback riding and hiking trails abundant.
items.name: Mustique horseback riding and hiking

items.details: Depart at noon; 6-hour cruise from Mustique to Young Island.
items.name: Cruise to Young Island (6 hours)

items.details: 35 acres of lush tropical vegetation 200 yards off Saint Vincent; beaches to yourselves.
items.name: Young Island private beaches

items.details: 6-hour cruise from Young Island back up the coast of Saint Vincent to St. Lucia; visit the Soufriere volcano on land before returning to port.
items.name: Cruise back to Castries (6 hours)

items.details: Visit on land after the return cruise, before returning to port in St. Lucia.
items.name: Soufriere volcano

itineraries.summary: A sample 7-day luxury yachting itinerary through the Windward Islands: boarding in Castries, St. Lucia, then cruising to Marigot Bay and the Pitons, Bequia, Union Island, Tobago Cays, Mustique and Young Island, returning via the Soufriere volcano. Each day pairs a cruise leg with snorkeling, diving or beach time.
itineraries.title: Windward Islands 7-Day Yachting Itinerary

items.details: Board the yacht at Newport Beach; 2-hour cruise to Catalina Island.
items.name: Cruise to Catalina Island (2 hours)

items.details: Drop anchor at the resort town of Two Harbors; snorkeling in clear waters, jet ski, or step ashore at the palm tree and cabana lined Descanso Beach in Avalon Bay.
items.name: Two Harbors snorkeling, jet ski and Descanso Beach

items.details: 5-hour coastal cruise from Catalina Island to Marina del Rey.
items.location: Catalina Island to Marina del Rey
items.name: Cruise to Marina del Rey (5 hours)

items.details: Step ashore for a stroll down the famous Venice boardwalk running along the coast from Marina del Rey to Santa Monica Pier.
items.name: Venice boardwalk stroll

items.details: 4-hour cruise northwards along the California coast towards Oxnard via Malibu.
items.location: Marina del Rey to Oxnard via Malibu
items.name: Cruise to Oxnard via Malibu (4 hours)

items.details: Tender ashore at Malibu for lunch at Nobu.
items.name: Nobu

items.details: Tie up at Oxnard's beaches; kayak or visit one of the many wine cellars.
items.name: Oxnard beach kayaking and wine cellars

items.details: 3-hour cruise from Oxnard to Santa Barbara; fresh seafood lunch prepared by the onboard chef.
items.name: Cruise to Santa Barbara (3 hours)

items.details: Jet skiing just outside Santa Barbara Harbor (sea lions on the buoys) or whale watching in the channel; stroll down State Street with its upscale boutiques.
items.name: Jet skiing, whale watching and State Street

items.details: Dinner ashore in Santa Barbara.
items.name: The Lark

items.details: Day on land: tour of the Santa Ynez Valley wineries; for children, relax along the beach and visit the Santa Barbara Botanic Garden or the Santa Barbara Zoo.
items.name: Santa Ynez Valley wineries or Santa Barbara Botanic Garden/Zoo

items.details: Depart early morning; 6-hour cruise from Santa Barbara to Channel Islands National Park.
items.name: Cruise to Channel Islands (6 hours)

items.details: Marine sanctuary with rugged landscape, natural arches and huge cliffs; cruise through the park exploring unique wildlife found nowhere else.
items.name: Channel Islands wildlife cruising

items.details: Late breakfast aboard, morning snorkeling among diverse marine life, kayaking into the sea caves, or lounging on the sunbed before the return cruise to Newport Beach.
items.name: Snorkeling and sea cave kayaking

items.details: 6-hour return cruise to Newport Beach.
items.name: Cruise back to Newport Beach (6 hours)

itineraries.summary: A sample 7-day luxury yachting itinerary along Southern California: Newport Beach to Catalina Island, Marina del Rey and the Venice boardwalk, lunch at Nobu in Malibu, Oxnard, Santa Barbara (jet skiing, whale watching, dinner at The Lark), a Santa Ynez Valley winery day, and Channel Islands National Park before returning to Newport Beach.
itineraries.title: Southern California 7-Day Yachting Itinerary

extractions.notes: YachtLife (yachtlife.com) publishes a library of sample 7-day yachting itineraries with explicit day-by-day cruise legs, named restaurants and activities. Two extracted here (Windward Islands, Southern California); others exist for New England, Saronic Islands, Belize, Montenegro, Catalina Island. The account appears brand/company-run rather than a personal influencer, but the itineraries are genuine structured trip plans, so they qualify.

items.details: Campsite in the town of Levanto used as the base for visiting Cinque Terre; small town they loved and would recommend.
items.name: Camping Acqua Dolce

items.details: First and favorite portion of the hike, from Levanto to Monterosso - peaceful with hardly anyone on the trail.
items.name: Coastal hike Levanto to Monterosso

items.details: The Cinque Terre day card lets you ride as many trains as you want to navigate between towns (but does not cover the boat trip).
items.name: Cinque Terre day pass trains

items.details: The Monterosso to Vernazza section is the only trail you have to pay for; described as a little pricey but the money goes to trail upkeep; trail was very crowded but the views of Vernazza from the top were breathtaking.
items.name: Paid coastal trail hike

items.details: Recommended especially when visiting Riomaggiore because it gives a completely different perspective.
items.name: Ferry to Riomaggiore

itineraries.summary: A structured one-day plan for Cinque Terre based in Levanto: hike the quiet coastal trail from Levanto to Monterosso, use the Cinque Terre day card trains between towns, hike the paid Monterosso-to-Vernazza trail, and take the ferry to Riomaggiore. Visited in mid-April when crowds were manageable.
itineraries.title: Cinque Terre Day Plan (Levanto Base)

items.details: Flew from Berlin to Faro to start the two-week trip.
items.name: Flight to Faro

items.details: Took the train from Faro to Olhao, then walked to the city port to catch the ferry.
items.name: Train to Olhao

items.details: Many ferries run from Olhao to Armona; only a 15-minute ride.
items.name: Ferry to Armona

items.details: Airbnb on the tiny, beautiful island of Armona; long stretches of beach, a few seafood restaurants, a small convenience store; grocery shopping at the big farmers market in Olhao.
items.name: Airbnb on Ilha de Armona

items.details: Spent 36 hours camping on the island; ferry from Peniche harbor (20 minutes); season runs May 20 to September 15; reservations with Viamar by calling (+351) 262 785 646 or at kiosks at the ferry harbor.
items.name: Camping on Berlengas
items.price_hint: 15 euro each way for the ferry (price varies by day of week, month, and day vs overnight)

itineraries.summary: Dana and Lou (Wild We Roam) spent two weeks in Portugal in 2016. The blog covers fragments rather than a full route: an Airbnb stay on Ilha de Armona in the Algarve (fly to Faro, train to Olhao, ferry to the island) and a 36-hour camping trip on Berlengas with ferry booking details. No day-by-day plan was published.
itineraries.title: Two Weeks in Portugal (2016 Trip Fragments)

extractions.notes: Wild We Roam's blog (wildweroam.com) is written as travel journal entries, not itineraries - day-trip reports without day counts or route structure. The Cinque Terre post is the closest to a structured plan (one day, ordered stops, named transport pass), hence medium. The Portugal entry is fragmentary (low). The Berlengas camping guide has concrete booking facts but is a how-to, not an itinerary, so its facts are folded into the Portugal fragments entry.
